HERO.TITLE: Manage your co-ownership with confidence, without being an expert.
HERO.TEXT: Units, documents, payment requests, and general meetings: find the essentials in one clear space designed for volunteer property managers.
HERO.TRIAL_NOTE: 30 days free, no credit card required
HERO.REASSURANCE: Just a few minutes each week
HERO.IMAGE_ALT: Preview of the MYB management workspace

PROBLEMS.TITLE: Managing a residence should not become a second job.
PROBLEMS.ERROR_TEXT: Legal procedures and accounts can be difficult to manage without guidance.
PROBLEMS.TIME_TEXT: Spreadsheets, emails, and reminders take time away from your personal life.
PROBLEMS.TRANSPARENCY_TITLE: You need to keep everyone informed
PROBLEMS.TRANSPARENCY_TEXT: Co-owners need an easy way to find decisions and shared documents.

SOLUTION.TITLE: Keep important tasks in one place.
SOLUTION.INTRO: MYB guides your day-to-day management and makes it easier to share information with co-owners.
SOLUTION.UNITS_TEXT: Keep unit details and associated contacts up to date.
SOLUTION.DOCUMENTS_TEXT: Find the documents you need without searching through emails.
SOLUTION.DOCUMENTS_ALT: Documents and information available in MYB
SOLUTION.FUNDS_TEXT: Prepare payment requests and track residence payments.
SOLUTION.FUNDS_ALT: MYB management view for a residence
SOLUTION.MEETINGS_TEXT: Prepare each step and keep decisions accessible.

STEPS.TITLE: Set up your residence in three steps.
STEPS.CREATE_TEXT: Add the initial details and create your units.
STEPS.INVITE_TEXT: Share a common space with residence members.
STEPS.MANAGE_TEXT: Keep documents, deadlines, and actions close at hand.

PRICING.TITLE: A plan that fits your residence.
PRICING.INTRO: Start with a free trial, then choose the plan that works for you.
PRICING.ESSENTIALS_TEXT: The tools you need to get your residence management started.
PRICING.COMFORT_TEXT: More ways to manage and share your residence information.
PRICING.TAX_NOTE: Taxes included. The free trial lasts 30 days.
PRICING.TRIAL_REMINDER: 30 days free, no credit card required.

SECURITY.TITLE: Your information deserves a clear framework.
SECURITY.INTRO: Your residence data matters. MYB puts privacy and support at the heart of the experience.
SECURITY.HOSTING_TITLE: Hosting in France or the EU
SECURITY.HOSTING_TEXT: Your data is hosted within a European framework.
SECURITY.PRIVACY_TEXT: Your information is considered from the very start of product design.
SECURITY.BACKUP_TEXT: Backups help preserve your residence data.
SECURITY.SUPPORT_TEXT: Our team is available to help you.

FAQ.TITLE: Need a little more information?
FAQ.INTRO: Answers to the first questions people ask before getting started.
FAQ.TRIAL_Q: How long is the free trial?
FAQ.TRIAL_A: The trial lasts 30 days. Explore the application before choosing a plan.
FAQ.PAYMENT_Q: Do I need a credit card to try MYB?
FAQ.PAYMENT_A: No. You do not need to provide payment details to start the free trial.
FAQ.DATA_Q: What happens to my residence data?
FAQ.DATA_A: You can review the applicable privacy information and terms on the dedicated pages of this site.
FAQ.SUPPORT_Q: Can I get help when getting started?
FAQ.SUPPORT_A: Yes. Contact the MYB team through the Contact page for assistance.
FAQ.COST_Q: How much does MYB cost after the trial?
FAQ.COST_A: Essentiel and Confort plans are shown above. Prices include taxes.
FAQ.CANCEL_A: Cancellation terms are described in the terms and conditions of sale.

FINAL.TITLE: A simpler way to manage your residence starts here.
FINAL.TEXT: Create your space and explore MYB for 30 days, with no credit card required.
